extDescription.message: Hands your browser’s downloads to Omni Download: multiple connections, resume, with the site’s cookies and referrer.

cmdDownloadPage.message: Download the current page with Omni Download

menuAll.message: Download this page’s file links with Omni Download…

notifyUnreachable.message: Can’t reach Omni Download. Make sure it is installed and running, or check the connection in the extension’s options.

notifyNoLinksRead.message: Can’t read the links on this page.

notifyNoFileLinks.message: This page has no links to files.

notifyQueued.message: Added to Omni Download for later: $1

sitesNeededHint.message: Reading the cookies of the site a download comes from, and taking a download over when you click it, both need this.

takeoverHint.message: Downloads you click go to Omni Download. Alt+click a link to let the browser download it.

minSizeHint.message: Smaller files stay with the browser; files of unknown size are taken over

onlyExtHint.message: Empty means every file. Separate with spaces or commas, for example: zip 7z iso

skipSitesHint.message: One per line; subdomains are included

silentHint.message: No confirmation window from Omni Download: downloads start with its default settings

connStateHint.message: Check that the extension can reach Omni Download

checkAppError.message: Omni Download answered with an error: $1

checkNoHost.message: Omni Download’s browser helper was not found. Install Omni Download and start it once.

checkUnpaired.message: The pairing code is no longer valid. Enter the current one.

pairBadFormat.message: That is not a pairing code. It looks like omnidl:port:token.

transportHint.message: Automatic: native messaging first, the fallback channel when it is unavailable

pairHint.message: For Snap and Flatpak browsers, which cannot use native messaging: turn on the fallback channel in Omni Download under Settings › Browser, and paste its pairing code here

downNotRunningHint.message: Choose Open Omni Download to start it. A download starts it too.

downNoHostHint.message: Install Omni Download and start it once. If it is installed, choose Rewrite messaging configuration under its Settings › Browser.

downUnpaired.message: The fallback channel is not paired

downUnpairedHint.message: Enter the pairing code from Omni Download’s Settings › Browser in the extension’s options.

downErrorHint.message: Make sure it is installed and running.

takeoverOn.message: Files of $1 MB and more go to Omni Download
